what: A registry of VERIFIED legal-AI adoption events in Saudi legal practice. It is empty on purpose.
why_empty: Nothing has been entered because nothing has been verified by this repository. An empty registry is a true statement about what we know; a registry populated from news summaries, vendor pages or inference would be a false one. UNKNOWN is a permitted and preferred value everywhere in this schema.
rules: An event is entered only with a citable source. No rumour, no inference from a product announcement that a workflow changed.
AI exposure is NEVER inferred from the style, length, punctuation or fluency of a document. No detector output may be entered here, and no document in this corpus is or will be labelled AI-written.
An event describes an institution and a workflow, never an individual lawyer, judge or judgment.
confirmed_status stays PENDING until the source is checked against the issuing body's own publication.
Entering an event does not license a causal claim. It licenses an event-study window, and the event-study contract in FORESIGHT.md requires the confounders to be recorded alongside.

schema.date: hijri and gregorian where both are known; UNKNOWN otherwise
schema.legal_domain: commercial | civil | criminal | administrative | general | UNKNOWN
schema.technology_type: retrieval | drafting assistant | translation | classification | general LLM | UNKNOWN
schema.source: url or citation to the issuing body's own publication
schema.notes: free text, including what the source does NOT say

adoptionThresholds.note: the observable conditions the conditional forecasts in FORECAST_LEDGER.json depend on. They are defined here, before any event exists, so that a future session cannot choose a threshold that makes a forecast look good.
adoptionThresholds.T_RESEARCH_DEPLOYED: at least 3 events with confirmed_status=CONFIRMED, source_quality=OFFICIAL, workflow_stage in {legal research, retrieval}, and actor_type in {court, ministry, regulator, legal research provider}, whose dates all precede the forecast window
adoptionThresholds.T_DRAFTING_DEPLOYED: the same, with workflow_stage=drafting and actor_type=law firm, from at least 3 distinct organizations
adoptionThresholds.T_COURT_DECISION_SUPPORT: at least 1 CONFIRMED OFFICIAL event with actor_type=court and workflow_stage in {decision support, judicial administration} and deployment_scope in {partial, institution-wide}
